The texture of the breading and the smooth flow of the sauce are clearly visible. (4) The scene shifts to a retail display featuring dozens of red and white boxes labeled 'Brassica'. He then lifts the whole item to his mouth for a massive bite, showing a wide-eyed, satisfied expression. (6) A woman with long reddish-brown hair wearing a maroon t-shirt appears, also eating the fried chicken doughnut. She looks directly at the camera while chewing, nodding and smiling to indicate her approval of the taste. (7) A final series of shots shows a classic custard-filled doughnut held up to the camera, followed by the male creator taking a bite that reveals the thick, yellow cream inside. The video ends with a shot of the food and a text overlay providing location details.
